svg.title: Deployment architecture: one image, two environments

g.text: Deployment architecture: one image, two environments
eth0 192.168.5.15 · Lima's SSH path for limactl shell/copy
image cs554-midterm:1.0.0 · env PORT, SERVICE_NAME, MESSAGE
curl · kubectl · limactl · docker build · k3d
VM's address on the NAT network
requestCount lives in this process's memory
ready Pod IPs (traffic goes only here)
docker save → limactl copy → docker load
HTTP, Compose: curl on the Mac → bridge100 → lima0:8080 → DNAT → container → node
HTTP, Kubernetes: client Pod → Service ClusterIP → kube-proxy → a ready web Pod
Image: built once on the Mac, copied into both environments (no registry)
Control: kubectl talks to the k3s API server
Container / Pod running the same image
The scheduler chooses each Pod's node, so placement varies between runs.
kubectl port-forward tunnels through the API server to one Pod.
